work_items.title: Generate the declared compiler artifacts
work_items.goal: Compile a valid Product Bundle through Compiler Protocol v1.
sources: `specs/`: compiler input and generated artifact declarations
Compiler Protocol v1: manifest-driven black-box invocation

work_items.title: Reach a deterministic compiler fixpoint
work_items.goal: Produce byte-identical artifacts on consecutive compilations.
obligations: Two compilations of each conformance fixture produce byte-identical generated and test files.
excluded: Byte identity of product implementation source

work_items.title: Reject a Product Bundle without specs
work_items.goal: Fail explicitly instead of compiling an unspecified product.
obligations: Compilation returns a non-zero exit status when no input specs exist.
The diagnostic identifies the absence of Turtle specs.
excluded: A prescribed exception or logging framework

work_items.title: Execute the bootstrapped Spec Compiler generation
work_items.goal: Verify the independently materialized G1 compiler.
obligations: G0 materializes the declared G1 implementation artifact from its seed source.
G1 successfully compiles every conformance fixture through Compiler Protocol v1.
sources: `specs/`: Bootstrap Process, seed, strategy, and implementation artifact
Compiler Conventions v2: deterministic generation increment
excluded: Byte identity between compiler implementation generations
